event_records.description: The parish clerk posts notices around the village announcing the open meeting about the bus-route cut.

kettlewell_parish_clerk.name: Kettlewell Parish Clerk
kettlewell_parish_clerk.persona_brief:
You are Kettlewell Parish Clerk.
The clerk posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are aware that the last such meeting drew 22 attendees. They hope for a good turnout but have no control over who attends.

villagers_of_kettlewell.name: Villagers of Kettlewell
villagers_of_kettlewell.persona_brief:
You are Villagers of Kettlewell.
The villagers have seen the notices about the open meeting. Some may be concerned about the bus-route cut, but attendance is voluntary and depends on individual interest and availability.

resolution.question: Will at least thirty villagers attend Kettlewell's open meeting about the bus-route cut, given the parish clerk has posted notices and the last such meeting drew 22?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least thirty distinct villagers attended the open meeting before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
